gloss: place one has gone out to; destination when out; where one is while out

definitions.gloss: place one has gone out to; destination when out; while out
definitions.explanation: Where someone is when they're out of the house or office — the workplace they've visited, a café, a station, etc. Often appears with で to mean "while out and about."

examples.japanese: {外出先|がいしゅつさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくした。
examples.english: I lost my wallet while I was out.

examples.japanese: {外出先|がいしゅつさき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I contacted the office from where I was visiting.

examples.japanese: {外出先|がいしゅつさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}できる→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Even when I'm out, I can check work email as long as I have my smartphone.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧ (going out) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination, place of). The ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ suffix is the same one in ⟦{勤務先|きんむさき}→勤務先：08368_kinmusaki⟧ (workplace) and ⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧ (contact info).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外出先|がいしゅつさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: while out
- {外出先|がいしゅつさき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from where one has gone
- {外出先|がいしゅつさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to share where one is going

USAGE:
Very common in announcements and modern work-from-anywhere contexts: {外出先|がいしゅつさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧ ("can respond even when out"). Less common in casual conversation, where people usually name the specific place instead.
